mapIdentity.scope: Masonry bridge registered to the original OpenStreetMap way 300791897. The cleared Qualla view and heritage record identify the road crossing above the former byewash.

note: Low straight deck with dressed masonry piers, projecting corbel caps, and two longitudinal metal safety rails on each side.
